037-A_ZeroLookaheadCausality.findings: Zero lookahead confirmed. Wick confirmation and macro baseline evaluated strictly causally using historical and completed candle data.

037-B_RejectionWickGeometry.findings: Lower and upper rejection wick ratios and candle polarity checks strictly enforced. Non-wick candles and zero-range candles yield NO_SIGNAL.

037-C_ReversedNegativeControl.findings: Negative directional control consistently inverts signals without statistical leakage.

037-D_LookbackGuards.findings: Model fails closed with INSUFFICIENT_LOOKBACK when either intraday (120m) or macro (1440m) window is incomplete.
